name: Claude
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, used to write, analyse, work through problems and handle longer documents, with separate plans for individuals, teams and enterprises.
features: Chat on web, desktop and mobile
Web search, file creation and code execution
Projects (up to 5 on the free plan)
Claude Code included with Team plans
strengths: Free plan includes web search, file creation and memory
Team and Enterprise plans add central billing, SSO and admin controls
limitations: Usage limits apply on every plan and reset on a rolling five-hour window; paid plans add weekly limits
The pricing page gives no fixed message count

plans.name: Free
highlights: Chat on web, desktop and mobile

plans.name: Max
plans.note: Shown as 'from $100 per month'; no separate annual price on the page

plans.name: Team (Premium seat)
highlights: 5x the usage of a Standard seat

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.billing: Billed annually, 20-seat minimum, plus usage at API rates
highlights: Compliance API, custom data retention, IP allowlisting

free.details: Free for everyone: chat on web, desktop and mobile, web search, file creation and code execution, memory, connectors, Artifacts, up to 5 projects. Usage limits apply.

api.summary: API usage is billed per million tokens (input/output): Fable 5.1 $10/$50, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 for prompts up to 100K tokens. Batch processing is stated as a 50% saving; web search is $10 per 1,000 searches; code execution includes 50 free hours per day per organisation, then $0.05 per hour per container.

pricing.regional: Displayed prices do not include applicable tax. US-only inference is available at 1.1x token pricing. Other regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Individual tab: Free $0; Pro $17/month on annual billing ($200 billed up front) or $20 billed monthly; Max from $100/month (5x and 20x tiers), monthly billing only. Team & Enterprise tab: Standard seat $20 annual / $25 monthly; Premium seat $100 annual / $125 monthly; Enterprise US$20 per seat per month billed annually, 20 seat minimum, plus usage at API rates. Prices exclude tax.
